Under the roof, each bay has a small recessed gray mounting pad, completely flush with underside, with no protruding machinery. Each bay has an empty gray floor landing area. Style: match the attached single-bay game sprite exactly in simple toy-like stylized 3D illustration, clean broad color blocks, soft bevels, restrained bolts. Teal #219da5, steel #555f69. No dispenser heads, no nozzles, no pistons, no cups, no cup stacks, no popcorn, no product, no workers, no front guard plate, no conveyor, no extra machine, no text, no numbers, no UI, no logos, no watermark. Never fill or obstruct the large open work bays. Do not redraw the reference scene.

Use case: background-extraction.
Edit target: the attached two-bay empty teal machine housing.
Primary request: Keep this exact machine housing geometry, colors, viewpoint, scale, lighting and all details unchanged. Remove EVERY checkerboard pixel from the exterior background and from BOTH open work bays. Replace these pixels with actual alpha transparency.
The supplied image mistakenly contains an opaque gray-and-white checkerboard; this is a defect. Output a PNG with a real alpha channel and alpha zero in all background and empty bay areas. Do not simulate transparency by drawing checkerboards, white, gray, black or any other opaque background. Return the isolated unchanged complete empty housing only, with clean anti-aliased edges and transparent outer padding.
No new objects, no text, no cups, no heads, no product. Keep the floor plinth opaque; the openings above the floor are empty transparent space.
